cases.name: split-lineage-mints-before-inserted
cases.notes: Mint order in pass 1 (README §5.1 step 4): lineage dispositions first — the two `split_from` fragments get b_2 and b_3 in recorded order — then `inserted` in document order, so the new paragraph that PRECEDES the split in the document gets b_4. The split paragraph itself is `deleted` (detail.splitInto) and pooled.
